items.title: Combinatorial Arbitrage in Prediction Markets
items.claim: Logical arbitrage across Polymarket contracts survived spreads and fees, yielding 2.2% guaranteed profit on settled portfolios in full-depth order-book replays.

items.title: Faithful by Construction? An Exact Test of LLM Explanations for Constrained Portfolio Optimization Decisions
items.claim: LLM explanations of linear-program portfolio decisions name zero-effect limits as drivers in 77-89% of cases, so they need solver-certificate checks.

items.title: Which Outcome Should Teach an LLM Reader? A Verified FOMC Benchmark and Reward-Design Evidence for Outcome-Guided Agents in Finance
items.claim: Pre-meeting equity returns are learnable from FOMC minutes at out-of-sample R² 0.50, while the next policy-rate change shows no detectable text signal.
